Aircraft Structural Integrity Components.name: Aluminum

Aircraft Structural Integrity Components.name: Titanium

Aircraft Structural Integrity Components.name: Carbon
Aircraft Structural Integrity Components.reasoning: Used in composite materials reinforcing structural components; valued for high strength and low weight; composites increasingly common though aluminum alloys still widespread.

Aircraft Structural Integrity Components.name: Steel Ingots
Aircraft Structural Integrity Components.reasoning: Used for high-strength reinforcements and fittings; heavier than aluminum but important in load-bearing or joint areas; alternatives like titanium used for weight savings but steel is cost effective.

Aircraft Structural Integrity Components.name: Epoxy resins
Aircraft Structural Integrity Components.reasoning: Used as matrix material in composite layups to bond fibers and provide rigidity; common in composite manufacturing though alternatives exist.

Aircraft Engine Power Plant.name: Nickel

Aircraft Engine Power Plant.name: Aluminum

Aircraft Engine Power Plant.name: Steel Ingots
Aircraft Engine Power Plant.reasoning: Base metal for many engine components requiring strength and durability; various steel alloys form critical parts of engine power plants.

Aircraft Engine Power Plant.name: Ceramic
